d: The Director, Cost Planning - General Business Unit is responsible for leading cost planning across major General, commercial, and mixed-use General-led developments within the General Business Unit. The role is accountable for setting and maintaining the Qiddiya cost position across a portfolio of larger, more complex projects, guiding strategic design-to-budget decisions, supporting executive and Stage Gate approvals, and ensuring that cost planning is integrated into business and project decision-making. In accordance with the Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, the role directs, reviews, and challenges the work of external cost consultants and internal project teams. The role may also be responsible for managing Qiddiya cost planning resources, including Cost Planning Senior Managers and other cost planning team members, to ensure appropriate leadership, capability development, and delivery oversight. While detailed cost planning may be prepared by cost consultants, Qiddiya cost planners remain accountable for defining requirements, assuring compliance, validating outputs, and recommending the cost position for endorsement and approval.

To lead cost planning activities for the General Business Unit across assigned portfolios, programs, and major projects, ensuring consistent application of the Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, effective leadership of cost consultants, robust cost governance, and high-quality strategic cost advice to support project, business, procurement, and Stage Gate decision-making.
q: This role is aligned to the Director skill profile within the Qiddiya cost planning framework and has been tailored to the General Business Unit. The role is expected to demonstrate a mature and highly competent capability profile, operating at Advanced level across core leadership, governance, stakeholder, and commercial capabilities, with strong authority in selected technical disciplines required to oversee larger, more complex General-led developments, lead Qiddiya cost planning resources, and shape the Qiddiya cost position at project and portfolio level.

Collaboration: Builds alignment across General BU leadership, development, design, commercial, finance, procurement, workplace, and project teams to support integrated delivery of major and complex General developments
Communication: Communicates complex cost positions, risk matters, and strategic choices clearly and credibly to senior stakeholders, governance forums, and cost consultants
Governance: Leads cost governance at project and portfolio level, ensuring compliance, consistency, and decision-ready reporting for Stage Gate and executive approvals
Influence: Exercises sound judgment and strong influence in challenging assumptions, driving alignment, and shaping investment and design decisions on complex projects

Leadership: Leads consultant teams and Qiddiya cost planning resources across multiple projects, sets standards, drives accountability, manages capability development, and may directly manage Cost Planning Senior Managers and other team members within the BU

Technical: Maintains and defends the Qiddiya cost position across major General developments; interprets project briefs, phasing, technical interfaces, and market conditions; and applies strong expertise in benchmarking, software-enabled review, and quantity-based validation to challenge consultant outputs
Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, or a related discipline
Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in cost planning, quantity surveying, or estimating, including significant experience on major General, or mixed-use developments
Demonstrated experience leading external cost consultants and reviewing consultant-produced cost plans across multiple design, procurement, and delivery stages
Strong knowledge of cost planning governance, benchmarking, design-to-budget principles, phasing, risk and contingency management, inflation, escalation, and cost reporting
Advanced proficiency in cost planning software and digital tools used to review, validate, and interrogate cost plans
Professional membership with RICS, AIQS, or equivalent is preferred
Experience operating within complex stakeholder environments, major governance frameworks, and executive decision-making settings is preferred
General Business Unit leadership and project teams
Central Development Unit Cost Planning team, including Cost Planning Senior Managers and other assigned resources
Development Management General and Stage Gate stakeholders
Design management teams, workplace stakeholders, and design consultants
Commercial, procurement, finance, project management, and operations functions
r: Lead cost planning activities across major General BU projects and portfolios, ensuring alignment with approved budgets, strategic objectives, benchmarks, cost drivers, risks, and opportunities

Direct the appointment, mobilization, governance, and performance management of executive and project cost consultants in accordance with the Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines and agreed scopes of service

Provide leadership, oversight, and, where applicable, line management for Qiddiya cost planning resources assigned to the General Business Unit, including Cost Planning Senior Managers and other team members
Support capability development, workload prioritization, performance management, and consistent ways of working across assigned Qiddiya cost planning resources

Establish requirements for consultant deliverables, methodologies, reporting standards, cost planning assumptions, and level of detail to ensure consistency with Qiddiya governance, procurement, and project stage requirements

Review, validate, and challenge consultant cost plans, reconciliations, benchmarks, escalation assumptions, risk allowances, phasing strategies, and design-to-budget recommendations before endorsing the Qiddiya cost position

Provide senior cost planning assurance for Stage Gate submissions, investment decisions, procurement strategies, and other governance approvals, ensuring that cost information is complete, accurate, and decision-ready

Maintain a current, defensible, and evidence-based cost position across assigned projects and portfolios, including key assumptions, cost movement, risks, opportunities, interfaces, and areas of uncertainty

Lead strategic design-to-budget decision-making by identifying major cost drivers, testing development and design options, and advising on the cost implications of scope, specification, phasing, and area changes

Provide early-stage and portfolio-level cost advice where required prior to consultant appointment or during business planning, using approved benchmarks, market intelligence, and Qiddiya methodologies

Work closely with development, design, commercial, finance, procurement, project management, workplace, operations, and CDU cost planning stakeholders to support integrated delivery of larger and more complex General projects
Apply cost planning software, benchmark data, quantity-based review methods, and relevant General development metrics to interrogate consultant outputs and strengthen cost confidence
Represent the General BU in cost planning, governance, and executive forums, and provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders on cost matters
Promote consistent ways of working, technical quality, capability development, and continuous improvement across the General BU cost planning function
Assigned projects and portfolios maintain a documented and current cost position, including key assumptions, risks, opportunities, interfaces, and cost movements

Cost planning inputs for Stage Gate, procurement, investment, and other governance submissions are compliant with the Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines and provided within required timeframes
Consultant-produced cost plans are reviewed and challenged at key design and procurement stages, with clear recommendations, actions, and endorsement positions recorded
Qiddiya cost planning resources assigned to the role are effectively managed, with clear priorities, consistent standards, and appropriate support for delivery and development
Material cost movement, cost risk, and non-compliance issues are identified, assessed, and escalated to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner
General benchmarking, market intelligence, and asset metrics are used effectively to support cost validation, option testing, and design-to-budget decisions
Cost consultant appointments, governance, and mobilization are managed to ensure continuity and quality of cost planning support across major projects
Stakeholder feedback reflects clear strategic communication, sound judgment, effective coordination, and strong leadership of cost planning activities and team resources

d: Mandarin Oriental, Doha is looking for a Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our Marketing Communications team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
r: Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Marketing Communications Department in Doha, the Graphic & Multimedia Designer is responsible for creating visually compelling and brand-compliant creative assets across print, digital, social media, photography, videography and multimedia platforms. As a brand guardian, the role ensures all visual communications align with Mandarin Oriental brand standards while supporting marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, guest engagement and commercial performance. The Graphic & Multimedia Designer reports to the Assistant Marketing Communications Manager.
As Graphic & Multimedia Designer, you will be responsible for the following duties
Design and produce creative marketing collateral including brochures, menus, advertisements, banners, invitations and promotional materials.
Create engaging visual content for social media, digital campaigns, website updates and email marketing initiatives.
Support photography, videography and multimedia production, including editing, retouching, motion graphics and short-form video content.
Collaborate with hotel departments, agencies and external vendors to ensure timely delivery of high-quality creative projects while maintaining Mandarin Oriental brand standards.
As Graphic & Multimedia Designer, We Expect From You

Degree in Graphic Design or equivalent, with 2-3 years of experience in graphic design, multimedia design or creative services. Experience within luxury hospitality, luxury retail, lifestyle brands or creative agencies is preferred.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro and After Effects, supported by a strong professional portfolio.
Strong creative, organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines while maintaining exceptional quality and attention to detail.
Understanding of luxury branding, visual storytelling and social media content best practices. Excellent English communication skills are essential, with Arabic being an advantage.
Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.

Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.
A competitive salary and benefits packages
